# DELETE /api/v1/user/applications/oauth2/{id}

Delete an OAuth2 application by ID

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-169`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| id | path | int64 | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **404** — Application not found or not owned by user
- **500** — Database error or builtin app locked

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.DeleteOauth2Application | controller | Parse appID from path; Call auth_model.DeleteOAuth2Application |
| 2 | [models](../modules/models.md) | auth_model.DeleteOAuth2Application | service | Check if app is builtin (locked); Delete app by id+uid; Delete related auth codes via grant join; Delete related grants |

### Datastore Operations

| Store | Type | Operation | Description |
|-------|------|-----------|-------------|
| [oauth2_application](../datastores/databases.md#oauth2_application) | database | SELECT | Get app to check builtin |
| [oauth2_application](../datastores/databases.md#oauth2_application) | database | DELETE | Delete app |
| [oauth2_authorization_code](../datastores/databases.md#oauth2_authorization_code) | database | DELETE | Delete related auth codes |
| [oauth2_grant](../datastores/databases.md#oauth2_grant) | database | DELETE | Delete related grants |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Builtin OAuth2 applications cannot be deleted | validation | app.ClientID is in BuiltinApplications() map |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| App ID not found in DB | 404 | not found | False |
| Attempting to delete a builtin app | 500 | internal error | False |

### Error Paths

- **App not found** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **App is builtin/locked** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500
